A new kind of tow truck company in Calgary

Wassi Towing Ltd. is a Calgary towing and roadside assistance company that covers every quadrant of the city: NW, NE, SW, SE, Downtown and the Beltline. Whether you need a tow truck after a breakdown on Deerfoot Trail, a battery boost on a minus-30 morning or a winch-out from a snowbank on Stoney Trail, one call gets the right truck moving.

We run flat deck (flatbed) tow trucks and wheel-lift units, so your car, SUV, EV or motorcycle is moved the safe way for its drivetrain and clearance. Every job starts with an upfront price you approve, and you get a text with your driver's name and a live tracking link.

settings.editor: Our services include flatbed towing, accident towing, roadside assistance and car lockouts, flat tire changes, fuel delivery, battery boosts, winch-out recovery, local hauling, motorcycle towing and exotic car towing.

settings.title: From “uh-oh” to “all good” in four steps
Call, text your location or use the quote tool.
Get your price and arrival time
You approve it before we dispatch. No surprises.
A live link shows the truck on the map and your driver's name.
Fixed on the spot, or delivered wherever you choose.
Built for Calgary roads and Calgary winters
The price we quote is the price you pay
Your quote includes the call-out, hook-up and the distance we discussed. If anything changes on site, the driver tells you the new price before doing the work.
Flatbeds, soft straps and wheel-lifts matched to your vehicle. Photos at every pickup.
A dispatcher, not a phone menu, [24/7, confirm].
From downtown parkades and Beltline side streets to Deerfoot, Stoney Trail and Crowchild shoulders, and the newest communities at the city's edge. If you're inside Calgary, we come to you.
